data.body: Run intake-55f8b3f6 implemented the change and passed the code-review, security-review, and acceptance gates, then the promotion policy denied it as ci_not_successful. config/local/checks.yaml had lost its archive-massgov-pfml entry, so the checks were skipped. The entry was rebuilt with image node:24.16.0-bookworm, working_dir /workspace/portal, a check command scoped to CHANGED_PATHS (eslint, prettier, tsc, jest --findRelatedTests, the Storybook axe test), and a fix_command running import-sort, prettier, and eslint --fix. This finding became ADEVX-149.
